reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Create #sig-cli by @jcogilvie in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6508", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Creating the #sig-cli community group or channel has no operational effect on a Crossplane installation.

proposed.statement: The release notes record the creation of a #sig-cli community group or channel, which does not appear to change any configuration, API or runtime behaviour.
